title.zh: 市场保护证书下的持续运行
title.en: Continued market operation under a protection certificate

claim.zh: 对每个过程与守卫：从某构型出发没有进程离开守卫，恰当某个证书含有它；证书是守卫之内、每一步都保持的集合，生存核是最大的证书。对由可容许扰动驱动的变化之律，给定一个可容许扰动，没有历史离开守卫，恰当某个含起点的集合在守卫之内且对每个可容许扰动封闭。市场律对每组参数、界与起点都是实例：没有可容许守卫历史违反必要底线，恰当这样的状态集存在。有效保护证书之下安全矩形就是这样的集，所以从安全初态出发、每步扰动可容许时，守卫历史在每个自然时刻与运行历史一致，没有支持失效。
claim.en: For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it: a set within the guard that every step keeps; the viability kernel is the largest certificate. For a law of change driven by admissible disturbances, given one admissible disturbance, no history ever leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The market law is an instance for every parameter set, bound set and start: no admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when such a set of states exists. Under a valid protection certificate the safe rectangle is one, so from a safe initial state with admissible disturbances at every step, the guarded history agrees with the operating history at every natural time without support failure.

hypotheses.zh: Certificate、Safe、Admissible 的全部公开条件，包括选择、责任、影响、资金及各支持底线；不是只检查维护份额。
hypotheses.en: All public Certificate, Safe and Admissible conditions, including selection, accountability, influence, funding and every support floor; renewal share alone is insufficient.

correspondence.zh: 量表示指定市场中的运行关系与支持，必要支持由 essential 指定；其正确性、伦理范围和真实参数另需对应。
correspondence.en: Quantities represent the specified market relations and supports; essential designates necessary supports. Correct mapping, ethical scope and actual parameters remain separate.

detail.zh: 新增结果放宽纠正参数，原范围继续保留和复用。
detail.en: The new result relaxes the correction parameter; the original scope remains preserved and reusable.

detail.zh: 已完成的有限支持阻碍，保留本记录较窄结论。
detail.en: Completed finite-support obstruction preserving this record’s narrower result.

detail.zh: 有限支持下低端吸引历史失败，表明一般物理初态不自动满足保护证书；保护范围也不是全体伦理后果。
detail.en: Low-attractor histories fail with finite support: a physical initial state does not automatically satisfy the certificate, nor does protection cover every ethical consequence.

detail.zh: Leaves.within_not_kernel：守卫本身未必是证书；needs_admissible：没有可容许扰动时历史条件空真而律不成立。
detail.en: Leaves.within_not_kernel: the guard alone need not be a certificate; needs_admissible: with no admissible disturbance the history condition holds vacuously and the law fails.

limitations.zh: 有条件的不失败结论；不提供从不安全初态的进入、不证明完整吸引域或现实市场必然服从。
limitations.en: Conditional nonfailure; it does not supply entry from unsafe states, a complete basin or inevitable compliance by real markets.

validation_scope.en: Migrates an existing claim from the original 39 results; the finite-transition check rebuilds and audits inherited source without counting it as new. General laws: checker receipts bound.

next_delta.zh: 已完成，直接复用；新研究须实际构造满足证书的状态或证明不同适用范围。
next_delta.en: Completed and reusable; new work must actually construct a certificate-satisfying state or establish a different scope.

history.en: 2026-10-14: under the general-law audit of older records, the claim now states the law first. New core module Becoming.Viability: no course leaves the guard exactly when a certificate contains the start, and under disturbances exactly when a set within the guard is closed under every admissible disturbance; the market law becomes an instance for every parameter set, bound set and start through the periphery MarketInstances, and safe_history_never_fails follows from the safe rectangle. Built with scratch_build: core axiom reports empty, the periphery with standard axioms only; the landing run binds the receipts. The original theorems, receipts and counterexamples are unchanged.
